title: Correct lowest/highest point
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify whether block A is at the lowest or highest point when the ground pressure is minimized.

title: Minimum pressure magnitude
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct final expression for the minimum pressure magnitude (e.g., Mg - 2mg).

title: Equilibrium spring extension
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the initial equilibrium extension of the spring due to the two blocks.

title: Amplitude of block A's SHM
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify that the amplitude of block A's oscillation equals the initial equilibrium extension.

title: Force analysis on the box
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the box, considering the spring force and weight.

title: Spring force at oscillation extremes
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the spring force on the box when block A is at the extremes of its motion.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student makes a sign error in the force equation for the box (e.g., incorrect direction of spring force).

title: Confusion about amplitude
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes the amplitude is different from the initial extension or misidentifies the equilibrium position.
